page: Microsoft Azure M96ls_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine in the MSMediumMemoryv4 family, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The hardware profile features 96 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. Memory provisioning totals 1536.0 GB of RAM, establishing a high-density allocation of 16.0 GB of memory per individual vCPU.

The virtual machine does not include onboard local disk storage or physical GPU accelerators. Disk operations require attached external volumes via the platform's Premium Storage capable interface. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying on virtual network infrastructure for address assignment and traffic routing.

From an infrastructure and cost efficiency standpoint, the M96ls_v4 provides a dense memory-to-core configuration suited for memory-bound systems that do not mandate high-bandwidth local ephemeral disks. Workload profiles appropriate for this instance include enterprise relational database systems, large in-memory operational databases, expansive caching layers, and high-footprint data processing tasks.
